Locate the ml-morph resources used by the digitizer's "Predict" button

Source: R/mlmorph.R
fm_mlmorph_resources.Rd

Resolves the three things a prediction needs: the folder of trained models, the Python interpreter (with numpy, opencv-python and dlib), and the worker script. Each argument wins when given; otherwise the environment variables, then the conventional locations are tried. Nothing here is required: when no model is found the digitizer opens as usual and the prediction button is simply disabled.

Usage

fm_mlmorph_resources(
  mlmorph_dir = NULL,
  predictor = NULL,
  python = NULL,
  check_python = TRUE
)

Arguments

mlmorph_dir

Folder holding mlmorph_run_*/predictor.dat (dlib) or mlmorph_run_*/model.onnx (neural network, needs onnxruntime) and the matching mlmorph_dataset_*/ (cnn, combined, campaign, app, aligned listed first, then any other mlmorph_run_<name>). NULL tries RFISHMORPH_MLMORPH_DIR, then INTRAITR_MLMORPH_DIR (the folder is shared with intraitR).

predictor

Optional path of one specific predictor.dat, listed first. Its training set is looked for beside it (mlmorph_run_X -> mlmorph_dataset_X).

python

Python interpreter. NULL tries RFISHMORPH_MLMORPH_PY, INTRAITR_MLMORPH_PY, ~/.venv_mlmorph/bin/python, <mlmorph_dir>/.venv_mlmorph/bin/python, then python3.

check_python

When TRUE (default) each candidate interpreter is asked to import numpy, cv2 and dlib, and the first that can is kept – a python3 without them would otherwise be picked silently and fail at the first prediction.

Value

A list: dir, python, worker, models, a data frame with one row per usable model (name, predictor, dataset), and global, the path of the GLOBAL network (mlmorph_run_global/model.onnx, train_global.py) used by the "Auto" button to find the snout, the caudal base and the dorsal side without any click (NA when absent). That folder is not a landmark model and is never listed in models.

See also

launch_fishmorph_digitizer()

Examples

res <- fm_mlmorph_resources(mlmorph_dir = tempdir())
nrow(res$models)   # 0: no model in an empty folder
#> [1] 0
